improvements.title: Thinking event threshold at high level
improvements.description: Thinking events are properly emitted in JSON mode starting at --thinking high level (18 events). Levels below high emit 0 events, matching expected behavior where model must reach certain thinking complexity threshold.

improvements.title: Model shorthand syntax supported
improvements.description: The model:thinking shorthand (e.g., claude-haiku-4-5:high) is properly parsed by --model flag. Thinking level may need to be specified via --thinking for full effect.

divergences.title: Thinking events not emitted for levels below high
divergences.expected: Thinking events might scale from minimal to xhigh
divergences.observed: Zero thinking events at levels off/minimal/low/medium; 18 at high; 20 at xhigh
divergences.impact: This appears to be Claude model behavior: extended thinking tokens are only produced when thinking level passes a threshold. Not a CLI bug—this is expected model behavior per Anthropic docs.

divergences.title: Latency consistent across high level tests
divergences.expected: High level might be slower than xhigh due to bounded thinking
divergences.observed: High level (13096ms) slightly faster than xhigh (12054ms). Difference within noise margin.
divergences.impact: Latency is stable and acceptable. No performance regression.
